counsel.note: PUBLIC KEYS ONLY. Counsel enrols an Ed25519 SubjectPublicKeyInfo PEM out of band; the private key never exists in this repository, in CI, or in any operator workstation checkout. Until enrolment, Gate F fails closed on the counsel approval.

founder.note: PUBLIC KEYS ONLY. Enrol the founder's Ed25519 public key with pnpm release:prepare-approval --print-enrolment; Gate F fails closed until then.

operations.note: PUBLIC KEYS ONLY. Operations may not sign counsel's role; role separation is enforced structurally by the signed payload's role field.

product.note: PUBLIC KEYS ONLY. Gate F fails closed until this role's Ed25519 public key is enrolled.

security.note: PUBLIC KEYS ONLY. Gate F fails closed until this role's Ed25519 public key is enrolled.

support_incident.note: PUBLIC KEYS ONLY. Gate F fails closed until this role's Ed25519 public key is enrolled.
